subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises and names some letters: 2 vowels and at least 6 consonants

show.line: a and i are vowels. Every word needs one! Cat has a. Pin has i. Listen in the middle.

rounds.prompt: Which word has a in the middle? Listen. Cat, pin.
Which word has i in the middle? Listen. Sat, sit.
Mat. What sound is in the middle? Say it.
Tin. What sound is in the middle? Say it.
a in the middle, or i in the middle? Sort the words.

hints: Say the word slowly. The middle sound is the vowel.
a opens your mouth wide. i is a small smile.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the vowel in pin.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The vowel in pin is a!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! p, i, n. The vowel is i.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it slowly. Piiin. The middle sound is i!

parent_line: Can hear the vowels a and i in the middle of short words.
